notes: Manufacturer technical data sheet (tannoypro.com V1.10, hosted copy retrieved via proacousticsusa.com; official tannoy.com product page returned 404 at time of research). This is a passive 8-inch Dual Concentric ceiling loudspeaker with 70V/100V/16-ohm transformer taps switchable via front rotary switch — it has no separate active power input; the single 2-wire screw-terminal connector carries the speaker-level signal from an amplifier/70V-100V line and doubles as the sole I/O, with loop-through to daisy-chain additional speakers. Mapped "removable locking connector with screw terminals" to the closest taxonomy id, euroblock (pluggable terminal block), though physically it is a 2-pole speaker/power terminal rather than a line-level audio euroblock connector. No bandwidth grade applies since this connector type is not in the graded list. rackUnits omitted (ceiling-mount device, not rack-mountable).

ports.name: Input (Loop-Through)
ports.note: Removable locking connector with screw terminals; 2-pole speaker-level input accepting 70V/100V transformer taps (60/30/15/7.5W) or 16 ohm direct; loop-through facility allows daisy-chaining to next speaker on the same terminal block. No grade applies (analog speaker-level line, not a data/video interface).
